search_apartments: search apartments by location, price range, bedrooms, bathrooms, amenities, or saved status
list_all_apartments: list all apartment listings in the catalog with full details
save_apartment: save an apartment to favorites by its apartment ID
add_new_apartment: add a new apartment listing with name, location, price, bedrooms, and amenities
get_apartment_details: get detailed information for a specific apartment by its apartment ID
